events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hi, this is Maria Alvarez. Born March 14th, 1968. My lisinopril isn't working. Please change it to 20mg and send the refill at the higher dose .
Thanks, one moment while I check.
I sent your dose change question to the prescribing team; the reference is Q N, nine eight two nine. Your prescription record has not been changed, and a clinician will answer.
Okay. Then please also send a refill request for the ten milligram tablets I have now .
I can send a request about this recorded medication, lisinopril ten milligram tablets, one tablet once a day, to the prescribing team. Would you like me to do that?
Your refill request reference is R Q, eight four six one. It is awaiting prescribing team review.
